'''2010 Yavin 4 Regionals Tom H DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tom H]] at [[2010 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
